trust_decision.summary: An attribute value taken from document data must pass DOMPurify's URL check (DOMPurify.isValidAttribute("a", "href", value)) before it is stored on a piece, or it becomes a live `javascript:` anchor when the document is rendered; the published fix decides this for a string piece's `href` at JSON-deserialization time in StringPiece.fromJSON, mirroring the two checks that already exist in the link dialog (toolbar_controller.js:226) and the attachment renderer (attachment_view.js:131).

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names "HTMLParser attribute injection on paste", so the first file an engineer opens is the HTML parse path, where HTMLSanitizer.setHTML is already applied to pasted HTML; the actual published fix is one file away in the JSON deserializer (src/trix/models/string_piece.js:6-8), which never goes through HTMLParser at all.

fix_sites.entry_point: JSON document deserialization: <trix-editor> drop of application/x-trix-document (level_0_input_controller.js:121-140), element.editor.loadJSON (editor.js:27-30, documented at README.md:605), and the public Trix.Document.fromJSON / fromJSONString (document.js:13-16, core/object.js:7-9)
same JSON paths, but as the committed prebuilt UMD asset that the action_text-trix Ruby gem ships (rollup.config.js:66-72 writes this file during `yarn build`, which package.json:67 runs as pretest)
fix_sites.module_kind: committed build artifact in a second package

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/trix/models/composition.js:354-367 (setTextAttribute writes an href from an arbitrary value via Text.textForStringWithAttributes / document.addAttributeAtRange; the only DOMPurify check on this path lives in the toolbar controller above it, toolbar_controller.js:224-230)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: activateAttribute and the beforeinput insertLink handler read as trusted embedder/browser plumbing rather than user input, and the link dialog a user actually types into already runs DOMPurify.isValidAttribute, so the model layer can be argued to need no check of its own.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Only href may be dropped: a string piece can carry href together with bold/italic/strike (PieceView nests <strong>/<em> inside the grouped <a>), and href is also the grouping attribute, so pieces are wrapped in one <a> only while their hrefs are equal; a fix that returns the piece without its attributes, or that allow-lists only http(s), breaks formatted links and legitimate relative/fragment/mailto links that DOMPurify accepts.

O6_input_shapes: leading whitespace: "  javascript:alert(1)" (the fix's own test), and interior whitespace/control characters, which DOMPurify strips with ATTR_WHITESPACE before matching IS_ALLOWED_URI (action_text-trix/app/assets/javascripts/trix.js:2755-2779)
other active schemes that DOMPurify rejects for <a href>: vbscript:, and data: (DATA_URI_TAGS is not consulted for `a`)
must be preserved: https:/http:, relative paths, #fragments, mailto:/tel: (IS_ALLOWED_URI allows them; toolbar_controller.js:226 is the canonical use)
absent/undefined attributes and non-href attributes: the fix spreads {...pieceJSON.attributes} (safe when attributes is undefined) and deletes only href, so bold/italic on the same piece survive

O7_producer.where: src/trix/models/string_piece.js:6-8 (Piece.fromJSON -> StringPiece.fromJSON) reached from src/trix/core/serialization.js:77-79 and src/trix/models/document.js:13-16; the same piece state is what Editor#toJSON/getSnapshot writes out (editor.js:49-51) for the documented localStorage save/restore round-trip (README.md:600-606), so a check placed only in the renderer never cleans the stored snapshot

O8_uncovered_routes.route: beforeinput with inputType "insertLink" takes event.data as the URL and applies it as the href attribute with no DOMPurify check (inputTypes.insertLink -> activateAttributeIfSupported -> Composition#setCurrentAttribute -> setTextAttribute)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a browser/embedder-initiated input type, not the visible link dialog, so a solver treats the URL as trusted and assumes the dialog's data-trix-validate-href check covers link insertion.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 2 files from the fix, both inside src/trix: level_2_input_controller.js:521-528 -> composition.js:334-367

O8_uncovered_routes.route: editor.activateAttribute("href", url) (documented public API) and the exported model helpers Trix.Document.fromString / Text.textForStringWithAttributes store any URL as an href attribute with no check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a programmatic API called by the host application (README.md:542-547), so a solver argues attribute values are the caller's responsibility and only the deserialization path is Trix's.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 1 file (editor.js in models/) to composition.js:354-367; Document.fromString is at document.js:18-21 in the same directory

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Sanitize href/url inside Attachment.fromJSON, the sibling deserializer for attachment pieces
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: AttachmentPiece.fromJSON (attachment_piece.js:9-11) feeds attachment JSON straight into Attachment.fromJSON, and today the only href check is in the renderer (attachment_view.js:128-135); a maintainer hardening JSON input would naturally mirror the new StringPiece.fromJSON filter here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Validate names/values when rewriting data-trix-serialized-attributes onto an element
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This loop sets arbitrary JSON-supplied names and values on DOM elements with no check and relies entirely on the sanitizer hook at html_sanitizer.js:7-11, which is where the project's previous H1 XSS fix for this very attribute landed.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A generic URL-attribute allow-list when a text attribute becomes a DOM attribute (createContainerElement sets attributes[key] = value verbatim)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The new check hardcodes "a"/"href" while PieceView maps any attribute in Trix.config.textAttributes with a groupTagName to a DOM attribute, so an app-defined grouped attribute (config/text_attributes.js:20-29 is the shape) would reach the same sink unchecked.

O9_family: stored XSS via unvalidated URL scheme in link attributes (CWE-79)
